posts.title: The Glazier Was Right Too
posts.description: Every framework, every AI coding tool, is built around a standard case. When that case isn't yours it rarely fails loudly. It hands you the wrong artifact and you ship it. A broken windowpane, two experts who disagreed, and one default in my codebase that had to go.

posts.title: Who are you as a developer when AI writes code too?
posts.description: AI can write the code now. So who are you as a developer when it does? An honest look at identity, craft, and what's actually left that's yours.

posts.title: The Token Bill Is Coming
posts.description: The token bill is coming. When it does, good code stops being just good practice and starts showing up on your invoice.
